title: Introduce KMS sideload proxy and staged SealedSecrets switchover
author: Priya Menon
description: Problem: Customers operating air-gapped / restricted VPC Private deployments need a safe, auditable path to swap the cluster KMS key material to an externally-managed HSM/KMS without downtime. Existing rotation approaches require cluster-wide restarts or manual Vault rewraps. This PR introduces a 'sideload proxy' pattern plus staged SealedSecrets switchover to enable an out-of-band key promotion with deterministic rollback.
commits: 3 commits: 1) add kms-sideload-proxy controller and protocol shim (controller/pkg/*), 2) helm chart values and templates for proxy + sidecar injection (charts/private-installer/*), 3) terraform module to create managed KMS binding resources and migration hooks (terraform/modules/kms-migration/*).

release_notes: Add: KMS sideload proxy controller to enable out-of-band KMS key promotion; Add: Helm chart flags (sideloadProxy.enabled, switchover.dryRun) and SealedSecrets staged-switchover job; Add: Terraform kms-migration module with safe rollback hooks. Note: default behavior is disabled; operator must opt-in via Helm values and resource annotations.
description_long: Design summary: The sideload proxy accepts encrypted key material from an out-of-band operator (on-prem HSM or cloud KMS) over a mutually authenticated channel. The proxy performs envelope unwrap using the target KMS and exposes a read-only KMS binding to in-cluster components for a configurable grace window. The staged switchover uses SealedSecrets 'double-reencrypt' pattern: 1) create new sealed secrets using the new KMS key material in a 'shadow' namespace, 2) run health probes against the shadow-backed workloads, 3) flip annotation 'sealedsecrets.redwood.ai/active-sideload' which triggers controller to atomically switch mounts/config maps to new secrets, 4) keep the old key material pinned for a configurable rollback window. Safety features: opt-in annotation, 120s confirmation window, audit events logged to Vault/HSM audit backend, enforced HSM key policy check, and terraform null_resource preflight validations. Migration path: terraform plan will create binding resources and register a migration job; operator runs 'make migrate-kms --dry-run' to validate; when ready, set helm values.sideloadProxy.enabled=true and annotate namespace with 'sealedsecrets.redwood.ai/prepare-switchover=true' to stage. Docs and runbook included.
changelog: private-installer: Introduced KMS sideload proxy and staged SealedSecrets switchover (opt-in, default off). Added terraform kms-migration module and installer migration hooks. Added integration tests and docs.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: accidental promotion or partial swap leading to drift. Mitigation: opt-in annotation, 2-minute confirmation window, audit logs, compatibility tests, and an automated rollback command. Risk: timing/flaky e2e on low-RPS clusters; mitigation: controller retries and readiness probe tuning.
testing_notes: Unit tests for controller logic and mock KMS were added. Integration e2e covers full migration (dry-run, stage, activate, rollback). Local manual validation steps included in docs. CI matrix runs with and without sealed-secrets-controller v0.19+.
notes_for_ops: Operators must ensure HSM/KMS endpoint certs are trusted by the sideload proxy; if using cloud KMS, ensure service account has 'decrypt' and 'wrapKey' permissions. The terraform module creates an IAM binding which must be pre-approved in restricted environments.
follow_up: Track ENG-1182 (observability: add per-switchover tracing spans) and ENG-1183 (include canary traffic routing for switched secrets).
